name: Tetrahedralization of Octree Cells
definition: A technique to generate a tetrahedralization of an octree to enable manifold isosurface extraction. It solves the problem of self-intersections and non-manifold vertices in adaptive octrees by creating a dual structure that ensures convexity and manifold topology.
summary: Tetrahedralization of Octree Cells extracts manifold isosurfaces from adaptive octrees by constructing a dual tetrahedral mesh that guarantees watertight topology, unlike Dual Marching Tetrahedra.
